notes.title: Demo is live!
notes.content:
I’ve opened a spot in Discussions → Bugs for issues and feedback—feel free to drop notes there or reply here.


Known Issues

- Crashes: If it goes plop and vanishes, please share what you were doing, your settings, and your specs—I’ll dive for it.


- FPS dip on big deletions: When you scoop out a large patch of detail, FPS may sink like a stone into pond mud. I’m on it and aiming to patch this soon.


Thanks for testing and helping the pond get clearer! 🌿🐟

notes.title: Dev Update: Multi-Theme Support & Reef Map Progress
notes.content:
Hello Pond community,

I’ve got a few developments to share today:
[olist]
Multi-Theme Architecture

You can now switch between different map themes. This framework will let expand with new environments more easily.

Current Map Lineup

Meadows Map

Reef Map (WIP)

Forest? Or magical forest?

Bug Fixes Underway

A handful of technical glitches remain. I’m addressing these now and expect to have them resolved soon.

Next Milestones

Polish and finalize the Reef map

Develop the main menu with map-selection UI

Implement core save/load functionality so your progress carries across themes
[/olist]
Thanks for your support and patience—more screens coming soon as features solidify!
